hypothesis: A versioned engineering-output profile can preserve all admitted MC-1 material/body semantics by separating programme authority from derived STEP geometry, using explicit grouped manifold-solid decomposition plus a binding manifest for singular/grouped nonempty states, and an explicit manifest-only empty outcome.
falsification: Reject the profile if it drops positive material, fuses durable bodies at zero-volume contact, invents residual material for empty states, treats auxiliary decomposition seams as physical material boundaries, lets STEP/kernel topology replace canonical body/lineage authority, or claims interoperability without source-bound native and independent-consumer evidence.

standards_sources.claim: advanced_brep_shape_representation accepts manifold_solid_brep/mapped_item members and requires at least one such solid-bearing item; the representation is not restricted to a single manifold solid.
manifold_solid_brep carries one outer closed_shell; singular/non-manifold material therefore cannot be made faithful merely by relabeling one manifold solid.

profile.primary_engineering_geometry: STEP advanced B-rep for every nonempty representable piece

authority_rules.canonical_material_authority: unchanged nominal material certificate/canonical journal result

classes.name: regular-nonempty-manifold
classes.step_policy: one or more ADVANCED_BREP_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION files/items containing faithful MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP/BREP_WITH_VOIDS as applicable
classes.manifest_policy: bind every emitted STEP artifact/item to canonical durable_body_id and lineage; no kernel handle is authority
classes.representation_piece_policy: not required unless a certified decomposition is needed

classes.name: multiple-disconnected-positive-volume-bodies
classes.step_policy: emit every retained body as a distinct manifold-solid item or distinct STEP artifact under one manifest; never keep only the largest body
classes.manifest_policy: one-to-one binding from each emitted body-level item to canonical durable_body_id plus lineage; body count and mapping are qualification observables
classes.representation_piece_policy: body-level items are not permitted to merge distinct durable bodies

classes.name: exact-zero-contact-between-distinct-bodies
classes.step_policy: retain separate manifold-solid items for the already-distinct durable bodies; touching boundaries do not authorize fusion
classes.manifest_policy: record exact-zero contact as a source-certificate-bound contact_relation, not as an inferred STEP tolerance event
classes.representation_piece_policy: no positive bridge may be inserted and no touching bodies may be fused

classes.name: touching-cavity-or-singular-nonmanifold-body
classes.step_policy: if one manifold solid cannot faithfully represent the material, emit a certified finite decomposition into regular positive-volume manifold representation pieces under one durable-body binding
classes.manifest_policy: all pieces retain the canonical durable_body_id/lineage; exact contact graph and union certificate are authoritative; auxiliary seams are declared NON_MATERIAL_PARTITION
classes.representation_piece_policy: piece interiors must be disjoint, the certified union must equal the canonical material set, and auxiliary partition faces must not be interpreted as physical material boundaries

classes.name: positive-micro-feature
classes.step_policy: use the ordinary faithful manifold/grouped route without rounding a positive feature to zero
classes.manifest_policy: bind protected-feature certificates and required accuracy budget to the emitted item(s)
classes.representation_piece_policy: decomposition cannot be used to erase the feature or bridge a certified positive gap

classes.name: empty-material
classes.step_policy: emit no nonempty STEP geometry; step_artifacts must be an empty list
classes.manifest_policy: record explicit EMPTY_MATERIAL result plus exhausted/disappeared durable-body and lineage transitions; absence of STEP is successful-by-contract only for this state
classes.representation_piece_policy: representation_pieces must be empty; no placeholder body, epsilon solid or empty STEP masquerading as nonempty geometry

grouped_decomposition_contract.allowed_only_when: single faithful conventional manifold-solid representation is unavailable or when multiple canonical durable bodies must remain distinct
piece_requirements: positive-volume unless the entire material state is EMPTY
pairwise interior-disjoint with all sibling pieces
certified union equals the canonical material assigned to the bound durable body
stable piece_id scoped to the output package
grouped_decomposition_contract.contact_semantics: exact-zero contacts come from the nominal/source certificate and are serialized in the manifest; STEP sewing/tolerance is not authority

consumer_evidence_plan.nonempty_route: Use MC-017's pinned BRL-CAD step-g strict/exact/no-repair path on the exact STEP bytes, then bind imported object inventory back to the manifest without geometric-nearest or largest-body heuristics.
required_controls: multi-body exact-zero-contact control with no fusion
grouped singular decomposition control with all pieces retained
empty manifest-only control with no STEP importer invocation
nonempty_acceptance: strict import is complete with no repair/inference
every manifest STEP item/piece is accounted for
durable-body and lineage bindings survive without guessing
no consumer fusion, dropped component, healed contact or invented material
downstream operation consumes imported geometry rather than replaying nominal machining authority
empty_acceptance: manifest validates EMPTY_MATERIAL and zero STEP artifacts
consumer harness returns NOT_APPLICABLE_EMPTY instead of fabricating geometry
